title: Quick Reference Guide for Archiving Emails
subtitle: M365 Outlook archiving

body.text: Archiving moves older emails out of your mailbox into a local archive (**.pst**) file, helping keep your mailbox within its size limit. Follow the four steps below.
In Outlook, click **File** at the top left, then go to **Tools > Clean Up Old Items**.

body.caption: The Outlook File page. Select Tools, then Clean Up Old Items.

body.text: Make changes to the settings as appropriate — choose the folder, your account, the cut-off date under **Archive items older than**, and the archive file location — then click **OK**.

body.caption: The Archive window. Select Archive this folder and all subfolders, then set the cut-off date and file location.

body.text: Archiving begins as soon as you click OK. Progress is shown in the Outlook status bar.

body.caption: Archiving progress appears in the Outlook status bar.

body.text: When archiving has finished, copy the **Archive** file to your Home drive for safe keeping.

body.caption: Copy the archive .pst file to your Home drive as a backup.

body.text: Tip: archiving can take several minutes. Do not close Outlook while it is running.
